competing_explanation: The policy may define the return window as 30 days from purchase or shipment, or it may have changed to a shorter or longer period, or to exchange-only for standard items.
hypothesis_statement: H_R: The current policy provides a 30-day full-refund return window for standard items, measured from the customer's receipt or delivery of the item.
refutation_criterion: Counterfactual evidence shows the current policy specifies a different number of days, a different start point such as purchase date or shipment date, or that standard items are not eligible for full refunds within 30 days.
